## How to act on this file (the receipt protocol, 3 lines)
Write one JSON file per event to `.oversight/outbox/` in this repo:
`<unix-ts>-<id>-<event>.json` -> `{"id":"J#217","event":"claim","session":"<surface/model/account>","note":"","at":"<ISO8601>"}`
Events a session may write: claim, done, applied, orphan, session-start, session-end, working, gate, assign, version, usage, archive, park, resume, depend, undepend, note, question, item, evidence, accept, run, interpretation, decision, stage.
`working` is different from the others (D20, 2026-08-26): no `id` -- instead
`{"event":"working","session":"...","target":{"d_number":"D14"},"at":"..."}`, written when you
start actively touching a specific D-number, so Axiom can show a live "someone is on this now"
indicator. Write one whenever you switch to a different D-number; it expires on its own after
20 minutes, so no matching "stopped" event is needed. `target.stage` is optional (D45 A6,
2026-08-31) -- free text (brief/spec/build/review/install/verify), tag it when you know which
stage the work belongs to so the cost register can eventually report real time-per-stage.
`gate` and `assign` are the same id-exempt shape as `working` (D28/D29) -- targeted by
`target.d_number` instead of an `id`. `gate` files a human gate verdict:
`{"event":"gate","session":"...","target":{"d_number":"D28","gate":"spec"},
"payload":{"verdict":"approve","approver":"ryan"},"at":"..."}` -- verdict is one of
approve/return_fix/return_redesign/reopen_fix/reopen_design/discuss (D45 A7 -- discuss requires
payload.note, same as the two return_* verdicts). The old `reopen` +
`payload.reason` (fix/change) shape is retired for new receipts (D33) and is now rejected
by the router; receipts already on record still parse and fold correctly forever.
The four jump-back verdicts (return_fix, return_redesign, reopen_fix, reopen_design) may
also carry `payload.note` -- it is folded into that D-number's own Pipeline State row as
the pickup note for whoever takes the work next, so write it for a reader, not a log.
`assign` nominates a model for a stage:
`{"event":"assign","session":"...","target":{"d_number":"D29","stage":"build"},
"payload":{"model":"sonnet"},"at":"..."}` (payload.model may be null to clear a nomination).
D45 adds seven more id-exempt events, same shape family, all targeted by `target.d_number`:
`version` (payload.version MAJOR.MINOR, payload.kind major|minor) -- a new pipeline pass began.
`usage` (target.stage, payload.version/model/input_tokens/output_tokens/source) -- a cost-register receipt.
`archive` (no payload) -- closed items only, folds to archived_at; a reopen verdict clears it.
`park` (payload.note required) / `resume` (no payload) -- a status overlay off the working board, reason on record.
`depend` (payload.on as {project,d_number} or {external,owner?}, payload.note optional) / `undepend` (payload.on optional --
clears one named edge, or every edge on this D-number if omitted) -- an edge with a named far side, replaces `blocked`.
D51 slice 1 adds six more id-exempt events, session-filed (no `id` field):
`note` (payload.text or payload.note; a target, or payload.request in lieu (D52 slice 1)) / `question` (same, plus
target.d_number or payload.request) -- a session leaving a comment or raising something for a human, without
necessarily having a D-number to point at.
`item` (target.item the BI-n id, target.r integer; payload.op one of add/revise/edit/retire/unretire, payload.text_hash,
payload.change the D-number this changeset belongs to, payload.version; revise/edit/retire also need
payload.against:{r,text_hash}, an optimistic precondition) -- a Blueprint Item write. `op:edit` is human-only.
`evidence` (target.items as a non-empty [{id,r}]; payload.kind one of tick/test/visual/static/receipt/not-automatable,
payload.result pass|fail; kind:not-automatable also needs payload.note) -- proof against one or more items.
`kind:tick` is human-only.
`accept` (target.artifact:{repo,path,sha256}; payload.for the D-number, payload.as one of required_input/authoritative,
payload.kind) -- always human-only.
`run` (target.d_number, target.stage; payload.model, payload.outcome one of accepted/revised/discarded) -- designed,
shape-checked, but nothing in this codebase files it yet (E6).
D51 job #768 ("stage as a fold", 2026-09-11) adds two more id-exempt events, session-filed (no `id` field):
`decision` (target.d_number; payload.track one of build/policy, payload.title, payload.stage 'brief' for
track:build or 'open' for track:policy, payload.note) -- records that a decision now exists. Any actor may
file it; a second `decision` for a d_number already on record is rejected.
`stage` (target.d_number; payload.op one of set/backfill, payload.stage one of brief/gate:brief/spec/gate:spec/
build/review/install/verify/closed, payload.terminal one of verified/decided/dropped/superseded:D<n> --
required when payload.stage is closed, absent otherwise -- payload.note required for op:set) -- sets a
decision's stage directly, outside a gate verdict. `op:set` is human-only, no grace period. `op:backfill`
may be filed by a model but requires payload.transcribed_from:{file,text} naming the human-authored source
it is transcribing.
Never edit ACTIONS.md itself; never write any other status. Ryan's tick happens in the app.
